header.title: System Overview
header.subtitle: What ProjectManager Pro is for, who uses it, its core modules and how to reach support.

intro.title: About
intro.description: Primary functions, core objectives, and problems solved
intro.body: is a construction project management platform that brings site work, quality control, procurement, warehousing, payments and permits into one place, and turns them into consistent, traceable digital workflows.

paperless.title: Eliminate Paper Processes
paperless.text: Real-time digital workflows replace paper inspection forms and manual sign-offs.

transparency.title: Enhance Transparency
transparency.text: Contractors, consultants and owners see quality status and pending actions as they happen.

auditability.title: Ensure Full Auditability
auditability.text: A complete history of every review, revision and approval, for contractual compliance.

one_place.title: One Place for the Project Cycle
one_place.text: From quotation to delivery and payment, and from inspection to certificate, without switching systems.

audience.title: Who Uses It
audience.subtitle: The parties, departments and roles the system serves within a project

contractors.title: Main Contractors
contractors.role: Execute site operations, create Work Inspection Requests (WIRs), track snag lists, and manage deliveries.

consultants.title: Consultants & QA/QC Engineers
consultants.role: Review and approve or reject inspection requests, issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and verify completed works.

managers.title: Project Managers & Executives
managers.role: Monitor project health and progress, approve certificates and payment orders, and review budget and audit logs.

finance.title: Accountants & Finance
finance.role: Request invoice originals, issue payment orders, pay subcontractor certificates, and follow deductions and financial reports.

supply.title: Procurement & Storekeepers
supply.role: Request and award quotations, issue purchase orders, receive deliveries, and issue or transfer materials between warehouses.

admins.title: Organization Administrators
admins.role: Manage members and invitations, set permissions and positions, and configure project details and system settings.

features.title: Key Modules & Features
features.subtitle: What the system offers for running a construction project, including the latest additions

wir.title: Work Inspection Requests (WIR)
wir.description: A digital workflow for submitting, reviewing and approving on-site inspection requests, with multi-step consultant approvals.

ncr_si.title: NCRs & Site Instructions
ncr_si.description: Issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) and Site Instructions (SI), and track corrective actions through to closure.

snag.title: Snag List
snag.description: Catalogue handover defects, assign who is responsible for each, track rectification, and export formal PDF reports.

checklists.title: Work Lists & Checklists
checklists.description: A shared library that links each activity to its checklist, so an inspection request starts with its items ready.

rfq.title: Quotations & Award
rfq.description: Create Requests for Quotation (RFQ), record supplier quotations, and compare them side by side before awarding.

purchase_orders.title: Purchase Orders
purchase_orders.description: Issue a purchase order automatically from the winning quotation or by hand, then track, receive and print it.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.description: Record material deliveries arriving on site and their receipt, linked to purchase orders.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Stock balances, approved issue vouchers, transfers between warehouses, low-stock alerts, and a full movement ledger.

materials.title: Material Gallery & Suppliers
materials.description: The project's material catalogue with photos and specifications, each material linked to its approved suppliers.

payments.title: Payments & Payment Orders
payments.description: Request invoice originals from the project team, then issue, approve and follow payment orders until paid.

sub_certificates.title: Subcontractor Certificates
sub_certificates.description: Prepared by the project team, approved by the project manager, then paid by accounting through a payment order.

deductions.title: Deductions & Fines
deductions.description: Record deductions and violations by issuing authority and liable party, and follow them until settled.

fin_reports.title: Financial Reports
fin_reports.description: Liability aging, expected cash flow, approval performance and subcontractor statements, all exportable.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Track project allocations, expenditure and outstanding financial commitments.

matrix.title: Progress Matrix
matrix.description: A weighted work breakdown (WBS) per project, with progress entered per unit, floor and building, and Excel import and export.

progress_certificates.title: Progress-Based Certificates
progress_certificates.description: Works out what can be claimed from actual progress (earned minus pending and paid), with cells locked once an approved inspection confirms them.

permit_catalog.title: Authority Service Catalogue
permit_catalog.description: Government and utility services a project goes through: steps, requirements, documents, fees and lead time.

permit_tracking.title: Transaction & License Tracking
permit_tracking.description: Start a transaction for a project and follow it step by step until the license is issued, with a reminder before it expires.

storage.title: Project Documents
storage.description: Central cloud storage for drawings, specifications, material submittals and site photos.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.description: Comprehensive, immutable logging of every action, keeping every project decision and approval traceable.

notifications.title: Notifications & Login Summary
notifications.description: Real-time notifications for what needs your action, and a summary of what is waiting when you sign in.

bilingual.title: Arabic & English
bilingual.description: The full interface in both languages, each with its own text direction; every user's choice is saved to their account.

erp.title: ERP Integration
erp.description: Receive suppliers and payment confirmations from ERPNext, and send system events to external systems through webhooks.

access.title: Organizations & Permissions
access.description: Manage organizations, members and invitations, and set what each role and position can do within a project.

support.title: Technical Support
support.description: Contact details for the system owner and the technical support team
support.company: Fursan Al Nama Company - Makkah, KSA
support.sla: Critical on-site inspection issues receive a priority response within 2 hours.
